description: This file contains functions and scripts for configuring and managing wireless network interfaces in a Linux-based system, specifically related to OpenWrt's netifd framework. It includes setup procedures, message handling, encryption parsing, and interface/VLAN/station management components.

methods.name: add_driver
methods.description: Initializes a driver and outputs its configuration in JSON format.

methods.name: wireless_setup_vif_failed
methods.description: Handles failure in setting up a wireless virtual interface.

methods.name: wireless_setup_failed
methods.description: Handles general device setup failure and triggers retry logic.

methods.name: prepare_key_wep
methods.description: Prepares WEP keys for transmission, converting them to hex if necessary.

methods.name: _wdev_prepare_channel
methods.description: Configures channel and hardware mode parameters based on JSON input.

methods.name: _wdev_handler
methods.description: Handles device-specific commands via evaluation of driver functions.

methods.name: _wdev_msg_call
methods.description: Sets JSON namespace, calls a command, and restores previous namespace.

methods.name: _wdev_wrapper
methods.description: Creates wrapper functions for message calls.

methods.name: _wdev_notify_init
methods.description: Initializes a notification JSON object with command and device info.

methods.name: _wdev_notify
methods.description: Sends a notification via ubus call with the current JSON data.

methods.name: _wdev_add_variables
methods.description: Adds variables to JSON object from arguments.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vif
methods.description: Adds a wireless Virtual Interface configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vlan
methods.description: Adds a VLAN configuration to the wireless device.

methods.name: _wireless_set_up
methods.description: Sends a command to set wireless device up.

methods.name: _wireless_set_data
methods.description: Sends a data update for wireless configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_add_process
methods.description: Registers a process related to wireless operation.

methods.name: _wireless_process_kill_all
methods.description: Kills all wireless-related processes with an optional signal.

methods.name: _wireless_set_retry
methods.description: Sets retry count for wireless commands.

methods.name: wireless_vif_parse_encryption
methods.description: Parses encryption settings for a wireless virtual interface.

methods.name: _wireless_set_brsnoop_isolation
methods.description: Sets bridge-snoop isolation parameters based on configuration.

methods.name: for_each_interface
methods.description: Iterates over configured interfaces and applies a given function.

methods.name: for_each_vlan
methods.description: Iterates over VLAN configurations.

methods.name: for_each_station
methods.description: Iterates over station configurations.

methods.name: init_wireless_driver
methods.description: Initializes wireless driver with dump or setup/teardown commands.
